postgres: PostgreSQL 18.6 (Debian 18.6-1.pgdg13+2) on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit
clock_boundary: Before docker exec/psql start through final process completion; includes TCP loopback PG protocol, binary COPY serialization, Docker stdout forwarding and host chunk sink. Not identical to EXPLAIN executor or direct-client fetch clocks.
first_header: Offset until the complete 19-byte COPY header is received; not HTTP TTFB.
byte_boundary: COPY payload only; PostgreSQL message and TCP framing bytes are not counted by the stdout sink.
oracle: Exact deterministic COPY byte count, complete binary header and EOF marker, successful psql exit, and uniquely tagged native QueryFinish result_rows=1000000. No per-row Python parsing.
